You see a health potion.
It weighs 2.70 oz.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 125 and 175 Hit Points, around 150 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Hit Point and Capacity Taken per Hit Point

History

  • The price was increased from 45 gp to 50 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 125x Health Potions went from 5 Tibia Coins to 6 Tibia Coins.
    • 300x Health Potions went from 10 Tibia Coins to 11 Tibia Coins.
